why: Veterinary clinics need appointment scheduling, pet records (vaccinations), pet food/drug sales with FEFO and reminders. Some controlled vet drugs are tracked like a pharmacy log.
operator: The vet sees animals across shifts. Their day is appointments, vaccination records, pet food/drug sales and controlled-substance tracking. Client consent is required for photos of pets.
entities: Clinic (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Pet (id, clinicId, name, species, breed, ownerName, ownerPhone, vaccinationRecord (array with vaccine type, date, nextDue), status, notes)
Appointment (id, clinicId, petId, dateTime, duration, type (consultation/vaccination/surgery), status, notes)
DrugSale (id, clinicId, productName, activeIngredient, quantityPiasters, costPiasters, taxRate, fe4oFlag, supplierId, expiryDate, status, prescriptionRequired)
ControlledDrugLog (id, clinicId, drugName, batchId, quantityPiasters, dateIn, dateOut, authorisedBy, reason, status (administered/sold/wasted))
Staff (id, clinicId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
units: visit, appointment, drug sale, controlled dose
batches: Yes for drugs and food: batches with supplier, received date, expiry date and cost, so the clinic can sell by batch and claim credit
expiry: Drugs and food have expiry dates tracked per batch; the clinic sees alerts for items expiring in 30/60/90 days
special: The core structures are the pet record with vaccination history, the drug sale with FEFO batch tracking, the controlled drug append-only log and the appointment system. Patient (pet) data has lower sensitivity than pharmacy but still requires consent for photos.
screens: Appointment calendar: day/week view with animal names, status colours and duration slots
Patient record: name, species, breed, owner name and phone, vaccination history (type, date, next due), notes, photo consent flag
Drug catalogue: list of drugs with active ingredient, price, FEFO flag, expiry date, supplier, reorder point
Controlled drug log: append-only list of administered/sold/wasted drugs with date, batch, quantity and authorised user
Drug sale screen: select drug, enter quantity, check FEFO expiry, record sale, compute price with tax
Vaccination reminder: list of pets due for vaccination, send notice
Staff shift: clock in/out, patient load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : appointments, drugs, controlled log, reports, billing
Vet: create appointments, prescribe drugs, view controlled log, approve administration
Veterinary assistant: enter drug sales, update controlled log, record vaccinations
Cashier: record drug sales, print receipt, shift close
reports: Vaccination compliance: pets due per period, by vaccine type, send-overdue notices
Drug sales by type and period: which drugs sell most, revenue per drug per month
Controlled drug log: administered vs sold vs wasted counts per period, audit trail
Appointment no-show rate: per period, by vet, with overdue notice rates
Drug expiry radar: items expiring in 30/60/90 days, value at risk
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for prescriptions and receipts
WhatsApp deep link for vaccination reminders and drug pick-up notifications
Email for vaccination records and prescription copies (opt-in)
onboarding: Clinic basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial drug catalogue: the starting list of common veterinary drugs with active ingredient, price and FEFO flag
Vaccination schedule: the standard vaccine types and dates for dogs/cats
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: set up first appointment type, first drug catalogue entry, first vaccination reminder
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the pet record/drug sale/controlled log schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add patient record with vaccination history
tasks.brief: Build the patient screen: name, species, breed, owner name and phone, vaccination history (type, date, next due), notes, photo consent flag. Done when the patient is saved with vaccination history and consent flag.
tasks.done: When patient record works with vaccination history and consent flag

tasks.title: Add drug catalogue with FEFO flag and expiry
tasks.brief: Build the drug catalogue: list of drugs with active ingredient, price, FEFO flag, expiry date, supplier, reorder point. Done when the catalogue loads and displays drugs with FEFO badge and expiry.
tasks.done: When drug catalogue displays live data with FEFO flag and expiry date

tasks.title: Add controlled drug append-only log
tasks.brief: Build the controlled drug log: append-only list of administered/sold/wasted drugs with date, batch, quantity, authorised user. Done when the log saves each entry as append-only and the audit trail is persistent.
tasks.done: When controlled drug log works end-to-end with append-only audit

tasks.title: Add drug sale screen with FEFO check
tasks.brief: Build the drug sale screen: select drug, enter quantity, check FEFO expiry, record sale, compute price with tax. Done when the sale saves and the FEFO expiry check works correctly.
tasks.done: When drug sale works end-to-end with FEFO check and price computation

tasks.title: Add vaccination reminder screen
tasks.brief: Build the reminder screen: list of pets due for vaccination, send notice (WhatsApp/SMS). Done when the reminder list pulls live data and the notice can be sent.
tasks.done: When vaccination reminder works end-to-end with notice sending

tasks.title: Add controlled drug log audit report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing administered vs sold vs wasted counts per period with audit trail. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures and the append-only nature is verifiable.
tasks.done: When controlled drug log audit report computes correctly from live data and shows append-only

tasks.title: Add drug expiry radar report (30/60/90 days)
tasks.brief: Build the radar report showing items expiring in 30/60/90 days and value at risk. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct buckets and values.
tasks.done: When drug expiry radar report computes correctly from live data and shows correct buckets

tasks.title: Add vaccination compliance report (due per period)
tasks.brief: Build the report showing pets due for vaccination per period by vaccine type, with overdue notice rates. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When vaccination compliance report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add appointment no-show rate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing no-show rate per period by vet, with overdue notice rates. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When appointment no-show report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial veterinary clinic setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: clinic basics, initial drug catalogue, vaccination schedule, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the clinic appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and clinic is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes patient and drug records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Controlled drug log without append-only enforcement and audit can violate legal requirements
Drug sales without proper prescription recording can violate veterinary regulations
